about: The largest size in bytes of each release binary of `just build-release` (stripped, with the ghostty screen backend). `just bench-size` fails when a binary is larger. The budgets of 2026-11-18 were the sizes of 3ef1f834 (0.0.12 and the libghostty-vt fixes: efrd 43199992, efr 14949848, efr-sbx 3560776) plus 2 percent. cargo bloat found no crate twice that matters and no feature on by accident in efr: the growth since the budgets of v0.0.4 is efr's own code of 0.0.5 to 0.0.12. It found one fault in efrd: `just build-release` builds the three binaries in one cargo run, so the regex features of efr's syntax colours (fancy-regex) join the regex of efrd, which costs efrd 1.15 MB (42053240 bytes alone). On 2026-11-19 each budget grew once by the measured growth of 0.0.13 (at 041e4e28: efrd 44653944, +1453952; efr 15194264, +244416; efr-sbx 3561648, +872). efrd added efr-media with the image crate (PNG and JPEG) and miniz_oxide (0.62 MB in the probe build), the attachments (the uploads, the intake, the blob dir and its cache), the Expo push client and the push service; efr added the @path words, the uploads, the row of a prompt with attachments and efr push test. The efr clip of a paste and the small pictures of attached images are not in this growth. Lower a budget when a change makes its binary smaller.
